Energy & Power Bid Analyzer - Dianlizhaobiaowang v1.0.0

- Initial release of the energy and power bid analysis skill for 电力招标网.
- Automatically triggered by queries containing 电网、电力、新能源、光伏、储能、风电.
- Focuses on aggregating and analyzing procurement projects from large central enterprises such as 国家电网/南方电网.
- Provides tools for bid searching, company profiling, competitor analysis, and market concentration metrics for specific energy equipment and engineering projects.
- Supports advanced filtering, grouping, and full detail retrieval for tender and award notices across key lifecycle stages.
